method.description: Stream-decompressed the exact KMX source stages and generated selector/product sections; counted CCX, CCZ, CSWAP, and TOFFOLI instruction lines per stage.

followup_screen.method: Stream scan for identical CCX/CCZ gates with the same explicit conditions, permitting cancellation only when intervening gates touch disjoint qubits and condition bits remain unchanged.

measurement_uncompute_screen.method: Streaming wire-taint screen: propagate nonlinear history from CCX/TOFFOLI targets through CX targets and reset the taint at HMR. This does not symbolically model inverse-gate cancellation or classical conditions.
measurement_uncompute_screen.interpretation: The release already contains substantial measurement of nonlinear-history wires. This count is a heuristic upper bound, not a measured saving or proof that all measurement-based uncomputation opportunities are exhausted.

decision: The D16 substitution blocks are too small to close the score gate, and the conservative decoder_return cancellation screen found no Toffoli-like pairs. Any next candidate must target algorithm-level reversible uncomputation and project at least 37,389 mean-Toffoli savings before a private full-verifier run.
